Why can a green SLA still produce quarantined stock?

A method-only case for aligning cold-chain service measures, product thresholds, dwell time and human review.

Anonymised caseAuthor: Pupsi PhullUpdated 20 September 2026
Evidence decision: owner approval permits anonymised case use. Company names are excluded; metrics remain omitted until source, period and baseline are verified.

Challenge

A consignment can meet a contracted time-and-temperature measure while still failing the product-specific operating threshold used by the receiving organisation.

Diagnosis

Map contracted milestones, product thresholds, packaging configuration, hub dwell, release dependencies and the customer decision that determines usable stock.

Rebuild

Align the measurement boundary to the product journey, set accountable dwell thresholds and retain qualified human judgement for disposition and regulatory decisions.

Questions for the reader

  • Which threshold determines customer usability?
  • Where does dwell accumulate?
  • Do the contract and product profiles use the same event boundary?
  • Who is accountable for reviewing an excursion?
